reading.body:
The CyrusOne Allen campus sits near Dallas Fort Worth and reports 77 MW of IT load across three connected facilities. Assuming 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, this translates roughly to 1,900 racks. The campus holds FISMA and HIPAA certifications, qualifying it to host federal workloads and regulated healthcare data.

Allen ranks second among the 18 Texas facilities that publish power consumption, representing 16 percent of the state's 468 MW of disclosed data center IT capacity. Texas has 133 mapped data center locations overall, most of which do not publish figures, so actual deployed capacity exceeds published capacity by an unknown margin.

The facility occupies 976,000 square feet across three buildings, a footprint large enough to support future expansion. Whether the campus can grow depends on grid availability at the Allen location, which is not published. CyrusOne operates multiple facilities across Texas, anchored by an earlier phase in the Dallas Fort Worth cluster itself, but individual site power constraints and grid interconnection status remain opaque to outside observers.
